name: separator
description: A visual divider between content blocks, decorative or semantic
designIntent: Separator creates visual rhythm between content groups. By default it is decorative; pass a label to make it a semantic divider that assistive tech can announce.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; when set, the separator becomes semantic

examples.title: Vertical divider

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Separator to create layout spacing
antiPatterns.explanation: Use margin/gap for spacing; Separator is for visual division.

accessibility.implementation: role="none" so screen readers skip unlabeled separators
accessibility.userRequirements: Only label separators that carry navigational meaning

guidelines: Use only when the boundary is meaningful
badExamples: This is a line separating sections

compositionRules.relationship: Separators pair with headings to divide long pages
